scope: Western Pokémon TCG. Base Knock Out Prize rules and modern Pokémon ex / Mega Evolution Pokémon ex. Not Standard admission, not Pokémon TCG Pocket, not older Mega Pokémon-EX. Card effects and other Rule Boxes require their own evidence; these base amounts do not override modifiers or prove a KO, promotion or win.

entries.label: Official Pokémon TCG rulebook — Knock Out Prize to hand
entries.appliesTo: Default award after a Pokémon is Knocked Out; a special Rule Box or card effect can change the amount.
entries.excerpt: That player’s opponent takes 1 of their own Prize cards and puts it into their hand.

entries.label: Official Pokémon TCG rulebook — modern Pokémon ex
entries.appliesTo: Modern Pokémon ex; Mega Evolution Pokémon ex use their separate three-Prize rule. Do not apply merely because a name contains a similar substring.
entries.excerpt: When one of your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

entries.label: The Pokémon Company International — Mega Evolution Series announcement
entries.locator: 26 September 2025, paragraph beginning When put into play
entries.appliesTo: Modern Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in the Mega Evolution Series, including Basic, Stage 1 and Stage 2. Not older Mega Evolution Pokémon-EX.
entries.excerpt: but give up three Prize cards when Knocked Out.
